name: Is it possible to adjust existing hardware or is replacement often necessary?

mainEntity.name: Is it possible to adjust existing hardware or is replacement often necessary?

acceptedAnswer.text: Many common issues with hardware, such as sticking doors, loose handles, or squeaky hinges, can often be resolved with simple adjustments, tightening, or lubrication. Replacement is typically only necessary if the hardware is severely damaged, worn beyond repair, or if a significant upgrade in function or aesthetics is desired. Our approach at Frasheski Construction is always to assess if an adjustment can provide a cost-effective and lasting solution before recommending a full replacement. This decision factor helps clients understand options.
acceptedAnswer.description: Often, existing hardware can be adjusted to fix common issues; replacement is usually only necessary if it's severely damaged or a major upgrade is desired.
